# EDA


# Frequentist Model

```{r}
dat <- rootData %>%
  mutate(
    Midline  = as.numeric(Midline),
    Length   = as.numeric(Length),
    root     = factor(root),
    side     = factor(side, levels = c("Inner", "Outer")),  # Inner as baseline
    Genotype = factor(Genotype)
  ) %>%
  arrange(root, side, Midline) %>%
  group_by(root, side) %>%
  mutate(
    Mid_c   = Midline - mean(Midline, na.rm = TRUE),  # center
    Mid_sd1 = (Midline - mean(Midline, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(Midline, na.rm = TRUE) # optional
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

get_starts <- function(d) {
  d <- d %>% filter(is.finite(Length), is.finite(Mid_c))
  list(
    Asym = max(d$Length, na.rm = TRUE),
    xmid = median(d$Mid_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    scal = max(sd(d$Mid_c, na.rm = TRUE), 1)  # keep > 0
  )
}

d_in  <- dat %>% filter(side == "Inner")
d_out <- dat %>% filter(side == "Outer")

st_in  <- get_starts(d_in)
st_out <- get_starts(d_out)

start_vec <- c(
  Asym  = st_in$Asym,
  xmid  = st_in$xmid,
  scal  = st_in$scal,
  Asym_sideOuter = st_out$Asym - st_in$Asym,
  xmid_sideOuter = st_out$xmid - st_in$xmid,
  scal_sideOuter = st_out$scal - st_in$scal
)
```

Work per genotype

```{r}
dat_wt <- dat %>% filter(Genotype == "WT") %>%
  group_by(root, side) %>%
  arrange(Mid_c, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(idx = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### Wild Type

```{r}

### Have a separate model for each of the roots 
### Write the function for SSfpl
### Have scal be a constant value and then have it increase or decrease based on an indicator value (1 for inner, -1 for outer) 

# Model for Each Root in Wild Type
WT_model_output = list()

for(root_num in unique(rootData_WT$root)){
  curr_root_inside <- rootData_WT |>
    filter(root == root_num & side == "Inner")
  inside.fit <- nls(
    Length ~ SSfpl(Midline, A, B, xmid, scal), 
    data=curr_root_inside,
    control = nls.control(maxiter = 500)
  )
  
  print(root_num)
  print(inside.fit)
  
  curr_root_outside <- rootData_WT |>
    filter(root == root_num & side == "Outer")
  outside.fit <- nls(
    Length ~ SSfpl(Midline, A, B, xmid, scal), 
    data=curr_root_outside, 
    control = nls.control(maxiter = 500)
  )
  
  print(root_num)
  print(outside.fit)
  
  WT_model_output[[paste0("model_", root, "_inside")]] <- inside.fit
  WT_model_output[[paste0("model_", root, "_outside")]] <- outside.fit
}
```

```{r}

# Wild Type One 
print("Wild Type One: Inner")
summary(WT_model_output[[1]])

print("Wild Type One: Outer")
summary(WT_model_output[[2]])
```

### Mutant Type

```{r}
MU_model_output = c()

# Mutant Type 
for(root in unique(rootData_MU$root)){
  curr_root_inside <- rootData_MU |>
    filter(root == root, side == "Inner")
  inside.fit <- nls(
    Length ~ SSfpl(Midline, phi1, phi2, phi3, phi4), 
    data=curr_root_inside, 
    control = nls.control(maxiter = 100)
  )

  curr_root_outside <- rootData_MU |>
    filter(root == root, side == "Outer")
  outside.fit <- nls(
    Length ~ SSfpl(Midline, phi1, phi2, phi3, phi4), 
    data=curr_root_outside, 
    control = nls.control(maxiter = 100)
  )
  
  MU_model_output = c(MU_model_output, inside.fit, outside.fit)
}
```

# Bayesian model

ACF plot (autocorr check)

```{r}
m0 <- lm(Length ~ side * poly(Midline, 2), data = rootData)
acf(resid(m0))  # if this shows notable autocorr, ARMA in the next step is justified
```
